purpose: Make Forecast Factory v1 compatible with Medallio's existing commercial_forecasting engine without falsifying interval, issuance, or cumulative-horizon semantics.
fixes: Prediction intervals may be NULL when temporal support is insufficient; absence blocks defendability rather than fabricating certainty.
Forecasts explicitly declare PERIOD_VALUE vs CUMULATIVE_WINDOW semantics.
Cumulative forecasts carry origin/window start/window end.
Evidence class supports SHADOW in addition to PROSPECTIVE and BACKTEST.
Legacy commercial_forecasting runs can be bridged idempotently into the canonical factory.
